title: C# Methods
description: A method is a block of code which only runs when it is called.

challenges.title: Create Method
challenges.exercise: Define a static method named 'MyMethod' that prints 'Hi'.

challenges.title: Call Method
challenges.exercise: Define 'MyMethod' to print 'Hi' and call it in Main.

challenges.title: Parameters
challenges.exercise: Create a method 'Greet' that takes string 'name' and prints 'Hello ' + name. Call with 'Aris'.

challenges.title: Return Value
challenges.exercise: Create a method 'Add' that returns int x + 10. Print Add(5).

challenges.title: Method Overloading
challenges.exercise: Print 'Method Overloading' to demonstrate you understand that methods can have the same name with different parameters.
